profile_text.body:
Speechmatics is a company founded in 2006 and headquartered in Cambridge, UK. It describes itself as building speech-to-text APIs for real conversations, not clean demos, and says its Voice AI understands accents, multiple speakers, and multilingual speech. The company's site states it offers sub-second, speaker-aware speech-to-text and text-to-speech across 55+ languages, with a flexible API and native integrations for AI voice agents. It also mentions a model called Linden, purpose-built for voice agents.

The site says its voice AI can reduce wait times, increase agent productivity, and improve customer experience in contact centers. It states that a single model transcribes 55+ languages, including code-switching when speakers change languages naturally, and lists use cases such as live captions, voice agents, meeting notes, and contact center analytics. A multilingual speech-to-text model with code-switching across 55+ languages is described as available in production preview, starting with batch transcription. The site also compares 12 text-to-speech APIs, including ElevenLabs, Google Cloud, Amazon Polly, and Speechmatics.

Additional recorded facts list the product as speech-to-text with real-time translation, accent-agnostic, UK-hosted, and GDPR.
